summary: Dependency resolved from a mutable third-party URL; shipped code is a stub re-export
details: package.json line 12 declares the package's only dependency, "linker-client-string-async", as a raw URL (https://artifacts.koliroute.com/npm/linker-client-string-async) instead of a registry version range. Running `npm install` fetches whatever bytes that host returns and installs them, executing any lifecycle scripts contained in the fetched tarball, with no version pin, no integrity hash, and no registry-side provenance. index.js is a one-line re-export of that dependency, so the manifest line is the entire functional surface of the package. The host is unrelated to any npm registry or declared repository, and its contents can change at any time without a new publish of this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
